notes:
Summary:
- Large North American outsourced contact center operator; ~20M tickets/year across email + chat. Cost-sensitive: primary KPI is deflection rate + $/handled-contact.
- Wants agent assist + first-touch deflection. Heavy peaks: weekday mornings, Black Friday-level spikes for retail clients. Must be resilient under spikes.

Technical requirements / paraphrase from calls:
- Workloads: high-volume chat deflection, short multi-turn chats (avg 6 messages), ticket summarization for routing, tool-calling integrations (CRM updates, ticket tagging).
- Latency target: p95 <= 200ms for deflection/quick-suggest flows; willing to accept ~500ms for longer summarization tasks.
- Throughput: need sustained 10k concurrent inference sessions during peak for multitenant customers; burst handling to 50k for sale events.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost-per-deflected-chat <$0.04. Explicit ask: show batching/caching strategy and quantization impact on unit economics.
- Model preferences: open model stack preferred (Llama-family / Mistral) with fallbacks to smaller quantized variants. Must support dynamic routing (low-cost fallback when busy).
- Data controls: VPC private endpoints, audit logs, retention controls; KMS integration required. No full air-gap; on-prem eval later if required by enterprise accounts.

- Track metrics: cost per deflected chat, median & p95 latency, tokens per request, cache hit-rate, fallback rate.
